implementation: ClosingBackend arms ordered storage cleanup only after source stop/join, exits, attachment, registry, online and remaining-policy close all succeed. RuntimeOwner phase rules require successful complete close before normal destruction.
Every opaque provider/capture retires while bound configuration, paths, auth and mutex cells remain live. Backend retirement is sealed and later member destruction does not repeat opaque retirement.

Ordinary standalone SourceBackend destruction keeps borrowed configuration unchanged. New explicit owner-only method requires stopped state and live configuration; complete-close/ownership is a caller precondition.

Storage body follows all40 native field groups. Path elements run forward; Content elements run forward with state/version/name/id; Entitlements forward with tag/type/version/group/id, before backing frees.
Optional immutable AuthenticationCode is legitimately destroyed at+138 after license path and before content_id; no const_cast or duplicate native destruction.
Host-only cached library path copies retire separately before native-group storage. FreeLibrary, online destruction, OS mutex destruction, joins and outer CRT are absent from this body.
Constructor-failure and never-published Runtime destruction preserve existing host cleanup. close() itself preserves configuration until actual owner destruction.
